senses.en: A place where people read or borrow books and other materials.

senses.zh: kho tư liệu; bộ sưu tập
senses.en: An organised collection of books, recordings, or digital resources.

ex.en: I borrowed three books from the library after school.
Public libraries support lifelong learning by providing free access to books, digital resources, and quiet study spaces.

tip: library là nơi mượn sách; bookshop là hiệu sách bán sách.

senses.en: the day after Wednesday and before Friday

ex.en: We usually meet for lunch at home on Thursday.
The university will host a public discussion on sustainable transport next Thursday evening.

tip: Tên các thứ trong tuần viết hoa chữ cái đầu; trước một ngày cụ thể dùng on.

senses.en: A room used mainly for sleeping.

ex.en: My bedroom gets plenty of sunlight in the morning.
Children who share a bedroom may develop cooperation skills, but they also need sufficient privacy as they grow.

col: share a bedroom｜ở chung phòng ngủ
bedroom furniture｜đồ nội thất phòng ngủ
tip: Danh từ đếm được; a two-bedroom flat là căn hộ hai phòng ngủ.

senses.en: items worn to cover the body

ex.en: Your clean clothes are drying outside in the sunshine.
Buying durable clothes rather than frequently replacing cheap garments can reduce household waste and save resources.

col: try on clothes｜mặc thử quần áo
tip: Chỉ có dạng số nhiều; một món quần áo dùng an item of clothing.

senses.en: having great physical power or force
not easily broken or damaged

senses.zh: mạnh mẽ; vững chắc; thuyết phục
senses.en: great in intensity, influence, or convincing power

ex.en: My brother is strong enough to lift this sofa.
There is strong evidence that regular physical activity improves both mental health and academic performance.

tip: strong at nghĩa là giỏi về; strong thường là tính từ.

senses.en: The whole physical structure of a person or animal.
An organized group with a particular purpose.
The main or central part of something.

ex.en: My whole body aches after yesterday's long walk.
An independent body should monitor water quality and publish its findings for the public.

col: a body of evidence｜một khối bằng chứng
the body of an essay｜phần thân bài của bài luận
tip: body có thể chỉ một tổ chức; body của bài luận là phần thân bài.

senses.en: one of twelve yearly divisions, or roughly four weeks

ex.en: I put aside a little money every month.
Offering employees one additional day off each month could improve wellbeing without significantly reducing overall productivity.

col: once a month｜mỗi tháng một lần
tip: Trước last, next, every month thường không dùng giới từ.

senses.en: To allow someone to do something or something to happen.
To allow someone to use property in exchange for rent.

ex.en: Please let me know when you arrive home safely.
Schools should let students explore different subjects before requiring them to choose a specialist pathway.

col: let a flat｜cho thuê căn hộ
let go of｜thả ra; buông ra
tip: let sb do sth không có to; quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là let.

senses.en: Brought into the world as a baby
Having a natural ability for a particular activity

ex.en: My little sister was born on a snowy morning.
Children born in rural areas may face greater difficulties accessing specialist healthcare than those in cities.

col: be born into a family｜sinh ra trong một gia đình
a born leader｜nhà lãnh đạo bẩm sinh
tip: Nói về sự ra đời dùng be born; quá khứ là was/were born.

senses.en: a coloured substance spread on surfaces for protection or decoration
to cover a surface with paint
to create a picture using paint

ex.en: There is blue paint all over your hands.
Schools should allow children to paint regularly, as creative activities can support emotional development and self-expression.

col: a coat of paint｜một lớp sơn
paint a picture｜vẽ một bức tranh
tip: paint thường chỉ vẽ bằng màu; draw thường chỉ vẽ nét bằng bút chì, v.v.

senses.en: To do something with a tool, resource, or method.

senses.zh: việc sử dụng; sự tận dụng
senses.en: The act of employing something for a purpose.
A purpose something serves or a way it can help.

ex.en: Can I use your scissors to open this package?
Governments should encourage people to use public transport by making services more reliable and affordable.

col: use public transport｜sử dụng phương tiện công cộng
a wide range of uses｜nhiều công dụng
tip: Động từ đọc /juːz/, danh từ đọc /juːs/.

senses.en: A period of sixty seconds, or a very short time
A written record of what happened at a meeting
Extremely small in size or amount

ex.en: Wait a minute while I find my keys.
Even a minute of regular classroom discussion can encourage students to reflect on what they have learned.

col: at the last minute｜vào phút chót
take the minutes｜ghi biên bản họp
tip: Biên bản họp dùng dạng số nhiều minutes; tính từ nghĩa “rất nhỏ” nhấn trọng âm ở âm sau.

senses.en: Used to emphasise something surprising or unexpected.
Flat, regular, or equal in amount or level.
Divisible by two without leaving a remainder.

ex.en: Everyone joined the dance, even our shy uncle.
Even small improvements in public transport can make daily travel easier for people with limited mobility.

tip: even if nói về giả định “dù cho”; even though nói về sự thật “mặc dù”.

senses.en: Used after a number to give the exact hour.

ex.en: Please meet me outside the library at three o'clock.
Starting school at nine o'clock rather than earlier may help teenagers concentrate better during morning lessons.

col: by ten o'clock｜muộn nhất là mười giờ
tip: Chỉ dùng cho giờ chẵn; viết là o'clock, không dùng dấu gạch nối.
note: Đã sửa cách viết không chuẩn o-clock thành o'clock.

senses.en: Relating to Australia or its people.
A person from Australia.

ex.en: We spotted several Australian animals at the wildlife park.
Australian universities attract international students through a combination of research opportunities and diverse academic programmes.

col: Australian wildlife｜động vật hoang dã Úc
tip: Tính từ chỉ quốc tịch viết hoa chữ cái đầu; chỉ một người Úc dùng an Australian.

senses.en: divide or remove something using a sharp tool
reduce the amount, size, or length of something

senses.zh: vết cắt; vết thương; sự cắt giảm
senses.en: an opening made by something sharp, or a reduction

ex.en: She cut the apple into slices for her brother.
Local councils can cut energy costs by installing efficient lighting in public buildings.

col: cut into pieces｜cắt thành miếng nhỏ
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là cut; hiện tại phân từ là cutting.

senses.en: Keep information in your mind or bring it back.
Not forget to do something necessary.
Honour someone or something from the past.

ex.en: I still remember the smell of my grandmother's kitchen.
Students often remember new vocabulary more effectively when they use it in meaningful conversations.

col: remember to do something｜nhớ làm việc gì
remember doing something｜nhớ là đã làm việc gì
be remembered for｜được nhớ đến vì
tip: remember to do là nhớ để làm; remember doing là nhớ đã làm.

senses.en: to stop sleeping, or make someone stop sleeping
the disturbed water left behind a moving boat
a gathering to remember someone who has recently died

ex.en: Please wake me before you leave for work.
People who wake at consistent times may find it easier to maintain healthy sleep patterns.

col: in the wake of｜theo sau; do hậu quả của
tip: Quá khứ woke, quá khứ phân từ woken; thường đi với up.

senses.en: liquid obtained from fruit or vegetables

ex.en: She squeezed fresh orange juice into a glass.
Although fruit juice contains vitamins, eating whole fruit usually provides more fibre and helps limit sugar intake.

tip: juice thường không đếm được; khi gọi món, a juice có thể là một ly nước ép.

senses.en: Used to make an adjective, adverb, or statement stronger.
In fact, rather than only apparently or supposedly.
Used in questions to express surprise or doubt.

ex.en: This soup is really hot, so let it cool.
Before expanding online education, policymakers should consider whether digital courses really meet the needs of disadvantaged learners.

tip: not really thường có nghĩa “không hẳn”, nhẹ nhàng hơn so với nói thẳng no.

senses.zh: thuộc Nhật Bản; thuộc tiếng Nhật
senses.en: Relating to Japan, its people, or its language.
The language used by most people in Japan.
A person from Japan, or the people of Japan collectively.

ex.en: We enjoyed Japanese food at a small restaurant yesterday.
Studying Japanese architecture can help students understand how traditional design responds to local environmental conditions.

tip: Luôn viết hoa chữ cái đầu; chỉ một người Nhật thường dùng a Japanese person.

senses.en: a large natural stream of water flowing towards another water body

ex.en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.

tip: Tên sông thường có the, ví dụ the River Nile.

senses.en: A large animal used for riding, racing, or pulling loads.

ex.en: The brown horse gently took an apple from my hand.

tip: Cưỡi ngựa dùng ride a horse; on horseback nghĩa là ngồi trên lưng ngựa.

senses.en: a meal eaten around the middle of the day
to eat a meal around midday

ex.en: We ate lunch under a tree beside the river.
Providing nutritious school lunches can improve children's concentration and support healthier eating habits over time.

tip: Nói chung về việc ăn trưa dùng have lunch, thường không có mạo từ.

senses.en: having greater than average height

ex.en: A tall tree shades our garden in the afternoon.
Tall buildings can accommodate more residents, but careful planning is needed to preserve sunlight and public space.

tip: Người, cây, tòa nhà thường dùng tall; núi thường dùng high.

senses.en: in addition to something already mentioned

ex.en: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
Public libraries provide free books, but they also offer valuable spaces for community learning.

col: also known as｜còn được gọi là
not only ... but also｜không những mà còn
tip: Thường đứng trước động từ thường, sau động từ be; không phải liên từ.

senses.en: an outer garment worn for warmth or protection
a layer of paint or another covering substance
cover a surface with a layer of something

col: a coat of paint｜một lớp sơn
tip: Động từ thường dùng coat A with B, nghĩa là phủ B lên A.

senses.en: A very large animal with a long trunk and large ears.

ex.en: The elephant sprayed water over its back with its trunk.
Protecting elephant habitats requires cooperation between conservation organisations, local communities, and governments across national borders.

col: a herd of elephants｜một đàn voi
tip: Số nhiều là elephants; vòi voi là trunk, không dùng nose.

senses.en: moving or happening at high speed
at high speed or within a short time
to eat no food for a period of time

Fast internet connections allow rural businesses to reach wider markets and compete with companies in major cities.

tip: fast tự nó có thể là trạng từ; không nói fastly.

senses.en: showing where someone or something starts or originates
showing what causes something
showing separation, difference, or distance

Students from rural communities may face additional barriers when applying to universities in major cities.

col: from start to finish｜từ đầu đến cuối

senses.en: At a fast speed or after only a short time.

col: as quickly as possible｜càng sớm càng tốt

senses.en: Something people do for enjoyment, learning, or a particular purpose.

senses.zh: sự hoạt động; tình trạng sôi động
senses.en: The state of being busy or doing things.

ex.en: Painting is my favourite activity on rainy afternoons.
Regular physical activity can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several long-term illnesses.

tip: Hoạt động cụ thể là danh từ đếm được; nói chung về mức độ hoạt động thì không đếm được.

senses.en: A settlement usually larger than a village but smaller than a city
The central area where people go shopping or do business

ex.en: Our town has a bakery beside the old bridge.
Improving public transport in a small town can help residents access jobs and essential services.

tip: go into town là đi vào trung tâm; lúc này town không có mạo từ.

senses.zh: không có; không dùng; không cùng với
senses.en: not having, using, or being accompanied by someone or something
not doing the action mentioned

ex.en: I left the house without my keys this morning.
Cities cannot achieve lasting reductions in air pollution without investing in reliable public transport.

col: without doubt｜không còn nghi ngờ gì nữa
without delay｜ngay lập tức; không chậm trễ
without saying a word｜không nói một lời
tip: without là giới từ, theo sau là danh từ, đại từ hoặc động từ thêm -ing.

senses.en: an image made by drawing, painting, or taking a photograph

senses.zh: bức tranh toàn cảnh; tình hình
senses.en: an idea or description of what a situation is like
to form an image of someone or something in your mind

ex.en: She hung a picture of the sea above her bed.
Survey results provide a clearer picture of how housing costs affect the wellbeing of young adults.

col: the bigger picture｜bức tranh toàn cảnh
picture yourself doing something｜hình dung mình làm việc gì
tip: take a picture là chụp ảnh; draw a picture là vẽ tranh.

senses.en: a young person who has not yet become an adult
someone's son or daughter, regardless of age

ex.en: The child carefully carried a bowl of water outside.
Every child should have access to quality education, regardless of family income or place of residence.

col: child development｜sự phát triển của trẻ
tip: Số nhiều là children; childish mang nghĩa chê (trẻ con), childlike chỉ sự ngây thơ như trẻ nhỏ.

senses.en: Caring about others and willing to help them.
A group of things sharing similar features.

ex.en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
Schools should encourage students to be kind to others, helping create a more supportive learning environment.

col: be kind to someone｜tử tế với ai
tip: Tính từ thường đi với to; chỉ loại dùng a kind of cộng danh từ.

senses.zh: không gì cả; không có gì
senses.en: not anything; no thing at all
not at all, used to strengthen certain comparisons

ex.en: I opened the fridge, but there was nothing inside.

col: nothing to do with｜không liên quan đến
for nothing｜không mất gì; vô ích

senses.en: the day after Monday and before Wednesday

tip: Tên các thứ trong tuần viết hoa chữ cái đầu; trước every Tuesday không dùng on.

senses.en: used to ask about the reason for something
introduces the reason for a situation or action

col: take off your hat｜bỏ mũ ra
tip: Đang đội mũ dùng wear; hành động đội mũ lên dùng put on.

tip: Không chỉ lao động chân tay mà còn chỉ người làm các nghề như y tế.

senses.zh: khoai tây chiên (Anh); khoai tây lát mỏng (Mỹ)
senses.en: fried potato strips in British English; thin slices in American English
small pieces broken or cut off a larger object
tiny electronic components containing circuits that process or store information

To continue doing something or do it repeatedly.

col: keep doing something｜tiếp tục làm việc gì
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là kept; tiếp tục làm gì dùng keep doing.

senses.en: On the side opposite the right.
Towards or on the side opposite the right.
Still available or remaining after others have gone or been used.

ex.en: I carry my shopping bag in my left hand.
Drivers should check their mirrors carefully before turning left, especially where cyclists share the road.

tip: Cũng là quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ của leave; khi mang nghĩa còn lại thì đặt sau danh từ.

senses.en: to move something into a particular place or position
to express something in a particular way
to cause someone or something to enter a particular state

ex.en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
Rising housing costs put considerable pressure on young people who are starting their careers.

col: put pressure on｜gây áp lực lên
put into words｜diễn đạt bằng lời
put something in place｜thực hiện một sắp xếp
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là put; nghĩa đặt để thường cần thêm địa điểm.

senses.en: the day after Saturday and before Monday

ex.en: We usually cook a big lunch together on Sunday.
Opening public libraries on Sunday allows people with busy weekday schedules to access essential community services.

tip: Tên các thứ trong tuần viết hoa chữ cái đầu; dùng on Sunday, nhưng next Sunday không dùng on.

senses.en: Having rain, either now or frequently.

ex.en: We stayed indoors and baked bread on that rainy afternoon.

tip: rainy là tính từ; đang mưa thì dùng It is raining.

senses.en: a building where people pay to stay in rooms

ex.en: Our hotel room overlooks a quiet sandy beach.
Building a new hotel near the station could create jobs and attract more visitors to the area.

col: book a hotel｜đặt phòng khách sạn
stay at a hotel｜ở khách sạn
hotel reception｜quầy lễ tân khách sạn
tip: Ở khách sạn có thể dùng stay at hoặc stay in a hotel.

senses.en: Clothing hanging from the waist, without separate sections for legs.

senses.zh: đi dọc theo rìa; đi vòng qua
senses.en: To move around the edge of something.
To avoid dealing directly with a difficult subject.

ex.en: Her blue skirt swayed as she walked upstairs.
Public discussions often skirt the issue of who should pay for environmental protection.

col: a knee-length skirt｜váy dài đến gối
skirt the issue｜né tránh vấn đề
skirt the edge of｜đi dọc theo rìa của
tip: skirt là chân váy; dress thường chỉ váy liền thân.

senses.en: An edge or surface of something, or the space beside it.
One aspect of something or one group in a disagreement.
To support one person or group in a disagreement.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the side door.
Public debates should consider both sides of an issue before any major policy decision is made.

col: the other side of the argument｜mặt còn lại của cuộc tranh luận
tip: side with là ủng hộ một bên; side by side là sát cạnh nhau.

senses.en: Attractive and pleasant to look at.
To a fairly large degree, especially in informal speech.

ex.en: We found a pretty cottage beside a quiet stream.
Although pretty public gardens attract visitors, cities must also ensure that these spaces remain accessible to residents.

col: a pretty village｜ngôi làng xinh đẹp

senses.en: To reach the place you were travelling to.
For an event or a particular time to come.

ex.en: Our guests arrived just as dinner was ready.
Reliable public transport helps employees arrive at work on time and reduces dependence on private cars.

col: arrive at the station｜đến nhà ga
arrive in a city｜đến thành phố
arrive at a conclusion｜đi đến kết luận
tip: Nơi nhỏ dùng at, thành phố và quốc gia dùng in; trước home không dùng giới từ.

senses.en: The capital city of the United Kingdom.

ex.en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring London by bus.
London attracts international students because its universities offer diverse courses and access to extensive cultural resources.

col: the London Underground｜tàu điện ngầm Luân Đôn
tip: Tên thành phố viết hoa chữ cái đầu; thường không dùng the.

senses.en: more than is wanted, needed, or suitable
in addition; also

Public transport cannot attract more passengers if fares are too high for regular commuters.

col: too tired to work｜mệt đến mức không làm việc được

senses.en: A hard, usually transparent material used for windows and containers.
A drinking container, or the amount it holds.
Lenses held in a frame worn to improve sight.

col: a glass of water｜một ly nước

A local policeman visited the school to explain how children can stay safe online.

col: uniformed policeman｜cảnh sát nam mặc đồng phục

senses.en: Used to connect alternatives or choices
Used to introduce what happens if something is not done

tip: Trong câu phủ định, nối các thành phần song song thường dùng or, không dùng and.

at a time in the past
as soon as something happens or becomes true

senses.en: a clothing item covering the foot and lower leg

col: a pair of socks｜một đôi tất

Writing a formal letter of complaint can encourage companies to address problems with their services.

senses.en: Not good in quality or not satisfactory.
Serious, unpleasant, or likely to cause harm.
Behaving wrongly or breaking accepted rules.

ex.en: The soup tasted so bad that I stopped eating.
Bad air quality can discourage outdoor exercise and increase health risks among children and older adults.

col: bad for your health｜có hại cho sức khỏe
tip: So sánh hơn worse, so sánh nhất worst; badly là trạng từ.

senses.en: The activity or skill of producing words on a surface.
The way someone's handwritten words look.
Written work, especially books, articles or literary material.

ex.en: I do most of my writing before breakfast.
Regular writing practice helps students organise complex ideas and communicate their arguments more clearly.

tip: writing thường không đếm được; cũng là hiện tại phân từ của write, bỏ e rồi thêm -ing.

senses.en: On or towards a higher floor of a building.
Located on a higher floor of a building.

ex.en: I left my glasses upstairs beside the bed.
Moving bedrooms upstairs can provide greater privacy in homes where the ground floor is used for work.

tip: Làm trạng từ thì phía trước không có to: go upstairs.

senses.en: The part of your face used for smelling and breathing.
The front part of an aircraft or similar vehicle.

ex.en: My nose turned red in the cold wind.
Wearing a mask over the nose and mouth can reduce exposure to airborne dust.

col: the nose of an aircraft｜mũi máy bay
tip: Xì mũi dùng blow your nose, không dùng clean.

senses.en: a card mailed without an envelope, often showing a picture

ex.en: She sent me a postcard from a seaside village.
Although digital messages are faster, sending a postcard can create a more personal connection between travellers and their families.

tip: Gửi cho ai có thể nói send someone a postcard hoặc dùng to để nêu người nhận.

senses.en: the body part containing the brain, eyes, and mouth
the person in charge of a group or organisation
to move or travel in a particular direction

ex.en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.

tip: head for + địa điểm nghĩa là đi về phía nơi nào đó.

senses.en: On the day before today.
The day immediately before today.

ex.en: I left my umbrella on the bus yesterday.
The transport survey published yesterday suggests that commuters increasingly prefer cycling to driving in city centres.

tip: Trước yesterday thường không dùng giới từ, thường đi với thì quá khứ đơn.

senses.en: A woman who serves food and drinks in a restaurant.

ex.en: The waitress brought us warm bread and fresh soup.
Working as a waitress can help students develop communication skills while earning money to support their studies.

col: work as a waitress｜làm nữ phục vụ bàn
a friendly waitress｜nữ phục vụ thân thiện
ask the waitress｜hỏi nữ phục vụ
tip: waitress chỉ riêng nữ; server không phân biệt giới tính.

senses.zh: cái gì đó; điều gì đó
senses.en: A thing that is not named or specified.

ex.en: There is something soft inside this little box.
Learning something new every day can help adults remain curious and adapt to changes in the workplace.

col: something to eat｜thứ gì đó để ăn
something wrong｜có điều gì không ổn
tip: Từ bổ nghĩa đặt phía sau, như something useful; làm chủ ngữ thì dùng số ít.

senses.en: An animal kept at home for company and pleasure.
To gently touch an animal with your hand.

ex.en: Our pet rabbit loves hiding under the kitchen table.
Caring for a pet can help children develop responsibility and learn to recognise the needs of others.

col: a pet owner｜chủ nuôi thú cưng
pet a dog｜vuốt ve con chó
tip: Quá khứ của động từ là petted; trong tiếng Anh-Anh, vuốt ve cũng hay dùng stroke.

senses.en: To end an activity or prevent something from happening.
A place where buses or other vehicles regularly collect passengers.

senses.zh: sự dừng lại; chỗ dừng chân
senses.en: An interruption of movement or a brief stay somewhere.

ex.en: We stopped walking when the rain became heavier.
Cities should improve public transport to stop traffic congestion from becoming worse as populations grow.

col: stop doing something｜ngừng làm việc gì
stop someone from doing something｜ngăn ai làm việc gì
tip: stop doing là ngừng làm; stop to do là dừng lại để làm.

senses.en: A period away from work or study for rest or travel.
An officially recognised day when many people do not work.
To spend time away from home for pleasure.

ex.en: We spent our holiday swimming and exploring quiet villages.
Flexible holiday arrangements can improve employee wellbeing while allowing businesses to maintain essential services throughout the year.

col: public holiday｜ngày nghỉ lễ theo luật
holiday entitlement｜số ngày phép được hưởng
tip: Tiếng Anh-Anh on holiday là đi nghỉ; tiếng Anh-Mỹ thường nói on vacation.

senses.en: the language originating in England and widely spoken internationally

senses.zh: thuộc tiếng Anh; thuộc nước Anh (England)
senses.en: relating to the English language, England or its people

ex.en: We practise English together while walking home from college.
Learning English can widen access to international research and help students communicate across cultural boundaries.

tip: Luôn viết hoa chữ cái đầu; English không đồng nghĩa với British (thuộc Vương quốc Anh).

senses.en: The forward part or outward-facing surface of something.
Located at or near the forward part of something.
A boundary where masses of warm and cold air meet.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the front door.
Placing bicycle racks at the front of public buildings can encourage more residents to cycle.

col: at the front of｜ở phần đầu của
tip: in front of chỉ phía trước bên ngoài; at the front of chỉ phần đầu của một vật.

senses.en: The dark part of each day when the sun is down.

ex.en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.

col: a good night's sleep｜một giấc ngủ ngon
tip: Nói chung ban đêm dùng at night; trước last night không dùng giới từ.

senses.en: say something to get information or an answer
say that you want someone to do or give something
invite someone to come somewhere or join an activity

ex.en: I asked the driver where the bus stopped.
Schools should ask students for feedback before introducing major changes to classroom teaching methods.

col: ask someone to do something｜nhờ ai làm việc gì
ask someone over｜mời ai đến nhà
tip: ask for theo sau là thứ muốn có; ask someone to do là nhờ ai làm gì.

senses.en: A short coat covering the upper body and arms.
An outer cover that protects a book or object.

ex.en: I grabbed my jacket before stepping into the cold.
A durable jacket made from recycled materials can offer consumers a more sustainable clothing choice.

col: a waterproof jacket｜áo khoác chống nước
tip: jacket thường là áo khoác ngắn, không chuyên chỉ áo phao.

senses.en: Having good things happen by chance.

senses.zh: được cho là mang lại may mắn
senses.en: Believed to bring good fortune.

ex.en: We were lucky to catch the last bus home.
Although some entrepreneurs benefit from lucky opportunities, long-term business success usually requires careful planning and consistent effort.

col: lucky enough to｜may mắn được làm
a lucky escape｜thoát nạn trong gang tấc
a lucky break｜cơ hội do may mắn mang lại
tip: “May mắn được làm gì” dùng be lucky to do something.

senses.en: Trousers made from strong cotton cloth, usually denim.

ex.en: These jeans are still wet from the wash.
Allowing employees to wear jeans may create a more relaxed workplace without necessarily reducing professional standards.

col: a pair of jeans｜một chiếc quần jean
tip: jeans dùng ở số nhiều; một chiếc quần dùng a pair of jeans.

senses.en: Burning that produces heat and light, sometimes causing damage.
To make someone leave their job.
To shoot a gun or launch a weapon.

ex.en: We warmed our hands by the fire after dinner.
Regular safety inspections can reduce the risk of fire in older residential buildings with outdated electrical systems.

col: fire an employee｜sa thải nhân viên
tip: catch fire là bắt đầu cháy; be on fire là đang cháy.

senses.en: a female sibling
a woman who belongs to a religious community

ex.en: My younger sister always borrows my favourite blue jumper.
Children who regularly share responsibilities with a brother or sister may develop stronger cooperation skills at home.

col: a twin sister｜chị em song sinh
a sister company｜công ty chị em
tip: sister không phân biệt chị hay em; cần older hoặc younger để chỉ rõ tuổi.

senses.en: The coldest season, between autumn and spring.
To spend the winter in a particular place.

ex.en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
Warmer winters can disrupt natural ecosystems by changing the seasonal behaviour of plants and migrating animals.

col: a harsh winter｜mùa đông khắc nghiệt
tip: Nói chung vào mùa đông dùng in winter; một năm cụ thể có thể dùng in the winter of...

senses.en: a trained professional who diagnoses and treats illnesses
a person who has earned the highest university degree
to change something dishonestly to deceive people

ex.en: The doctor listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
Governments should train more doctors to ensure that rural communities have reliable access to healthcare.

col: see a doctor｜đi khám bác sĩ
a doctor of philosophy｜tiến sĩ triết học
doctor the evidence｜làm giả bằng chứng
tip: Đi khám bác sĩ thường nói see a doctor; động từ doctor có thể nghĩa là làm giả.

senses.en: Flat bread baked with toppings such as tomato sauce and cheese.

ex.en: We shared a mushroom pizza after the film.
Although pizza is convenient, its nutritional value depends largely on the ingredients and portion size.

col: a slice of pizza｜một miếng pizza
order a pizza｜gọi một chiếc pizza
tip: Cả chiếc đếm được: a pizza; nói chung về món ăn có thể dùng some pizza.

senses.zh: một đôi; một cặp; một chiếc (kéo, quần)
senses.en: Two matching things, or one object with two connected parts.
Two people who are together or work together.
To put people or things together in groups of two.

ex.en: I left my favourite pair of gloves on the bus.
Teachers often pair students with different strengths to encourage cooperation and improve learning outcomes.

col: a pair of shoes｜một đôi giày
a pair of scissors｜một chiếc kéo
work in pairs｜làm việc theo cặp
pair up with someone｜ghép cặp với ai
tip: Khi a pair of shoes làm chủ ngữ, động từ chia số ít.

senses.en: a person who studies at a school, college, or university

ex.en: A student left her backpack under the library desk.
Universities should ensure that every student can access affordable housing and appropriate support throughout their studies.

tip: student không chỉ là sinh viên đại học; pupil chủ yếu chỉ học sinh tiểu học và trung học.

senses.en: Used when you are both the subject and object.

senses.zh: đích thân bạn; bản thân bạn
senses.en: Used to emphasize the person being addressed.

ex.en: Be careful not to cut yourself with that knife.
Preparing meals yourself can reduce household spending while giving you greater control over nutritional quality.

col: help yourself to｜cứ tự nhiên lấy
tip: Ứng với you số ít; nói với nhiều người thì dùng yourselves.

senses.en: The amount of money needed to buy something.
Something unpleasant experienced to achieve or obtain something else.
To decide how much money something will cost.

ex.en: The price of fresh strawberries has fallen this week.
Rising food prices place considerable pressure on families with limited incomes, particularly in urban areas.

col: reasonably priced｜được định giá hợp lý
tip: Giá cao hay thấp dùng high hoặc low; hàng hóa đắt hay rẻ dùng expensive hoặc cheap.

senses.en: Final in a sequence, or most recent before the present.
To continue for a period or remain usable.
After everyone else, or on the most recent previous occasion.

ex.en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
Products that last longer can reduce household spending and limit the amount of waste sent to landfill.

col: last for years｜kéo dài nhiều năm
last a lifetime｜dùng được cả đời
tip: last week là tuần trước; the last week có thể là tuần cuối cùng.

senses.en: to pay attention to sounds or what someone is saying
to take someone's advice or warnings seriously

ex.en: I listen to music while cooking dinner every evening.
Local authorities should listen to residents before making decisions that significantly affect their neighbourhoods.

col: listen to advice｜tiếp thu lời khuyên
tip: Có đối tượng phải dùng listen to; hear nhấn vào kết quả nghe thấy.

senses.en: Having very little money or few possessions
Of low quality or lacking something necessary
Deserving sympathy because of an unfortunate situation

ex.en: The poor family could barely afford fresh vegetables.
Poor public transport can limit employment opportunities for people living far from major urban centres.

tip: poor at là kém về; poor in là thiếu cái gì.

senses.zh: phòng tập thể dục; nhà thể thao
senses.en: A room or building equipped for exercise and sport.

senses.zh: môn thể dục; hoạt động thể chất
senses.en: Physical exercise taught or practised at school.

ex.en: I usually go to the gym before work.
Affordable gym membership can encourage regular exercise, although safe outdoor spaces are equally important for public health.

col: go to the gym｜đi tập gym
gym membership｜thẻ hội viên phòng tập
tip: gym là dạng viết tắt của gymnasium; đi tập gym dùng go to the gym.

senses.en: The activity of understanding written words.
A measurement shown by an instrument.

senses.zh: buổi đọc; buổi đọc diễn cảm
senses.en: An occasion when someone reads a written work aloud.

ex.en: Reading before bed helps me relax after a busy day.
Regular reading exposes students to varied vocabulary and helps them develop stronger critical thinking skills.

tip: Chỉ hoạt động đọc thường không đếm được; chỉ số đo hoặc buổi đọc thì đếm được.

senses.en: A stringed musical instrument played by plucking or strumming.

ex.en: My sister plays the guitar beside the window every evening.
Learning to play the guitar can help students develop patience, coordination, and confidence through regular practice.

tip: Chơi guitar thường nói play the guitar.

senses.en: A substance used with a toothbrush to clean teeth.

ex.en: I squeezed some toothpaste onto my brush before breakfast.
Regular brushing with fluoride toothpaste helps prevent tooth decay and can reduce the need for costly dental treatment.

col: a tube of toothpaste｜một tuýp kem đánh răng
fluoride toothpaste｜kem đánh răng có fluoride
squeeze out toothpaste｜bóp kem đánh răng
tip: toothpaste không đếm được; một tuýp dùng a tube of toothpaste.

senses.en: The star that gives Earth light and heat.
The light and warmth coming from the sun.
Sit or lie where sunlight warms your body.

ex.en: The sun appeared just as we reached the beach.
Energy from the sun can provide a renewable alternative to fossil fuels in regions with suitable conditions.

tip: Chỉ mặt trời thường dùng the sun; in the sun là dưới ánh nắng.

senses.en: a country in western Europe whose capital is Paris

ex.en: We travelled through France by train last summer.
France attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed transport networks.

tip: Tên nước France viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường không dùng the.

senses.en: feeling strong displeasure about something unfair, wrong, or unpleasant

ex.en: He felt angry when someone damaged his bicycle.
Residents became angry about the council's decision to close the only library in their neighbourhood.

col: angry about something｜giận về việc gì
tip: Giận ai dùng angry with; giận về việc gì dùng about.

senses.en: A powered flying vehicle with fixed wings.

ex.en: The aeroplane flew low over the sandy beach.
Travelling by aeroplane connects distant communities, but its environmental impact has encouraged debate about alternative transport.

tip: Tiếng Anh-Anh dùng aeroplane, tiếng Anh-Mỹ dùng airplane; trong khẩu ngữ hay dùng plane.
